entity_raw.definition_raw:
You become more aggressive and vicious when you taste living flesh and blood.

Prerequisite(s): Bite attack.

Benefit(s): When you damage a living creature with your bite attack, you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls with your bite attack until the end of your next turn.
